question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
WITH team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        home_team AS team,
        SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
    FROM match_view
    GROUP BY league, home_team
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        league,
        away_team AS team,
        SUM(CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
    FROM match_view
    GROUP BY league, away_team
),
team_wins_combined AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        team,
        SUM(wins) AS total_wins
    FROM team_wins
    GROUP BY league, team
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        team,
        total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team ASC) AS rn
    FROM team_wins_combined
)
SELECT league, team, total_wins
FROM ranked_teams
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league
